verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments API platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask. The evidence pack never mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The MCP 'branch' parameter applies to documentation branches, not API versioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
